description: This file defines the RelationDao interface for managing entity relations in the Thingsboard platform, including methods for querying, saving, and deleting relations.

classes.name: RelationDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to entity relations within the platform.

methods.name: findAllByFrom
methods.description: Finds all relations originating from a specific entity, optionally filtered by relation type group.

methods.name: findAllByFromAndType
methods.description: Finds all relations from a specific entity with a specific relation type.

methods.name: findAllByTo
methods.description: Finds all relations pointing to a specific entity, optionally filtered by relation type group.

methods.name: findAllByToAndType
methods.description: Finds all relations to a specific entity with a specific relation type.

methods.name: checkRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a relation exists between two entities.

methods.name: checkRelation
methods.description: Checks synchronously if a relation exists between two entities.

methods.name: getRelation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relation between two entities.

methods.name: deleteOutboundRelations
methods.description: Deletes all outbound relations from an entity.

methods.name: deleteInboundRelations
methods.description: Deletes all inbound relations to an entity.

methods.name: findRuleNodeToRuleChainRelations
methods.description: Finds relations between rule nodes and rule chains.

methods.name: findByRelationPathQuery
methods.description: Finds relations based on a relation path query.

search-terms: rule node to rule chain relations
